events.detail: Observed roadmap launch items for ECC Tools billing/Marketplace still marked as dry-run; public copy drafts claimed general availability.
Retrieved roadmap launch gates, the Marketplace listing draft, the billing audit checklist, and the dry-run release evidence pack.
Proposed two candidates: 'evidence-backed-billing-check' (audit-gated launch checklist) and 'announcement-first-billing-copy' (publish launch copy immediately).
Verifier compared both against roadmap acceptance criteria, the billing audit, and the Marketplace listing state; announcement-first failed every gate.
Promoted 'evidence-backed-billing-check'; publication of listing or announcement copy remains blocked pending audit sign-off.
